description: This file defines the configuration class JwtSubjectIssuersConfig, which manages a collection of subject issuer configurations for JWT authentication in a security service. It includes methods for creating configurations from OAuth settings, retrieving configuration items by issuer or SubjectIssuer object, and handling protocol prefixes.

classes.name: JwtSubjectIssuersConfig
classes.description: Immutable configuration class managing JWT subject issuer configurations, supporting creation from different sources and retrieval of configurations based on issuer or SubjectIssuer.

methods.name: fromJwtSubjectIssuerConfigs
methods.description: Creates an instance from an iterable of JwtSubjectIssuerConfig, using a default protocol.

methods.name: fromOAuthConfig
methods.description: Creates an instance from an OAuthConfig, merging openID connect issuer entries.

methods.name: getConfigItem
methods.description: Returns the JwtSubjectIssuerConfig for a given issuer, if any.

methods.name: getConfigItems
methods.description: Returns configuration items associated with a specific SubjectIssuer.
